records.name: Khakassia
records.summary_text:
The national framework governs this division: legal gender transition is banned, trans-specific healthcare is effectively banned since 2023, no discrimination protection exists, and same-sex marriage is not recognised. Enforcement is live: the 'extremist movement' designation had produced 101 convictions by June 2025 (98 administrative, 3 criminal), and repeat display of banned symbols is punishable by up to four years in prison.

records.summary_text:
